title: What Should a Workplace Chemical Register Contain?
seoTitle: Workplace Chemical Register: What to Include | Fit2Trade
description: A practical Ireland, UK and US guide to workplace chemical registers: what to list, how to link SDSs and risk assessments, and how to keep records current.
excerpt: A useful chemical register identifies every hazardous product and process-generated substance, where and how it is used, its hazards, the current SDS and the risk assessment or control that applies.
author: Fit2Trade
